decisions.reason: Glass-silicon wafers with through-glass vias sit at the core of Plan Optik's specialty glass-wafer competence, so one year of uncertain results falls within normal aspiration tolerance and does not call for problemistic search to redeploy resources.

Carrier wafers are a low-cost extension of the existing glass-wafer production line with modest resource demands, so the firm can carry them on available slack while demand from customers handling smaller wafers develops.
